calc_mae()

calc_rmse()
Calculate Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE)

calc_runs_test()

calc_nn_mismatch()

calc_between_dataset_silhouette()

calc_kde_ise()
Calculate 1D Kernel Density Estimation Integrated Squared Error (KDE-ISE)
calc_fasano_franceschini()
Calculate Fasano-Franceschini 2D Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test Statistic
calc_kde_test()
Calculate 2D Bivariate Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) Test Statistic

calc_all_bivariate_metrics()

Category 5: Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity

Evaluation of differentially expressed genes (Simpipe framework; Duo et al., Genome Biology 2024) and differentially accessible regions via pseudobulk edgeR-QLF (Libra framework; Squair et al., Nature Communications 2021; Teo et al., Nature Communications 2024).

Run edgeR QLF Differential Expression with Cellular Detection Rate (edgeRQLFDetRate)
calc_simpipe_deg_ratio()

calc_simpipe_distribution_score()
Calculate Simpipe P-value Uniformity Distribution Score (Approach 2)
evaluate_predictive_de_model()
Predictive Cell Identity Classification Using Simulated DEGs (Simpipe Approach 3)
evaluate_deg_fidelity() evaluate_rna_de_fidelity()
Evaluate scRNA-seq Differential Expression (DE) Fidelity (Sub-category V-A)

Binarize Single-Cell Count Matrix (scATAC-seq Feature Binarization)
to_pseudobulk()
Construct Pseudobulk Count Matrices from Single-Cell Data (Libra Engine)

Run edgeR-QLF Differential Accessibility (DA) Analysis on Pseudobulk Data (Libra Engine)
evaluate_atac_da_fidelity()
Evaluate scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility (DA) Fidelity (Sub-category V-B)
